Delay is 2.6× over target (337 ps vs 150 ps). Energy is at 94 fJ against a 100 fJ limit, so I'll refine the sizes before changing the topology.

The sensitivities point to more input-pair and tail current, and less inverter loading on the latch nodes. A stronger latch should also speed up regeneration of the 1 mV input. I'm also shrinking the reset devices to recover some energy. If the search can't reach 150 ps within the 100 fJ limit, the next step is an edit that adds a buffer stage at the output.
